job.job_description:
Project Role : LLM Full Stack Engineer


Project Role Description : Develop and integrate applications with Large Language Models (LLMs) and other enterprise services. Leverage front-end and server-side technologies to develop APIs, implement DevOps practices, and optimize Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications.


Must have skills : Generative AI


Good to have skills : NA
Minimum
3 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education


Summary:
As a Large Language Model Full Stack Engineer, a typical day involves designing and building applications that seamlessly integrate with advanced language models and various enterprise systems. The role requires balancing front-end and back-end development tasks, creating robust application programming interfaces, and ensuring smooth deployment through continuous integration and delivery practices. The engineer actively collaborates with cross-functional teams to enhance the performance and scalability of artificial intelligence solutions, while continuously refining the user experience and operational efficiency of the applications.


Roles Responsibilities:

Expected to perform independently and become an SME.

Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.

Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.

Collaborate with team members to identify and resolve technical challenges in application development.

Assist in documenting development processes and best practices to support knowledge sharing.

Support junior team members by providing guidance and sharing expertise to foster professional growth.


Professional Technical Skills:


Must To Have Skills:

Proficiency in Generative AI.

Experience with front-end and back-end development technologies relevant to AI applications.

Familiarity with application programming interface design and implementation.

Understanding of DevOps methodologies and continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines.

Ability to optimize AI models and applications for performance and scalability.

Strong problem-solving skills and capability to work with complex systems.

The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Generative AI.

This position is based at our Pune office.

A 15 years full time education is required.


Qualification 15 years full time education
